item.title: UX/UI Designer Needed for a Modern Digital Marketplace Platform
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | Project Type: Freelance / Contract Experience Level: Intermediate to Expert Engagement: Project-Based (Potential for Long-Term Collaboration)
Project Overview
We are looking for a talented and experienced UX/UI Designer to help us design a modern, intuitive, and visually appealing marketplace platform.
Our goal is to build a user-friendly digital marketplace that provides a seamless experience for buyers and sellers. We need a designer who can transform business requirements into clean, professional, and engaging user interfaces while ensuring excellent usability across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Key Responsibilities
- Design modern, intuitive, and visually appealing UI/UX for our marketplace platform. - Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes. - Design essential marketplace features, including: - User registration and login. - Buyer and seller dashboards. - Product/service listing and management. - Search, filtering, and navigation. - Product/service detail pages. - Shopping cart and checkout experience. - User profiles and account settings. - Order management and transaction history. - Develop a consistent design system, including typography, colors, buttons, and reusable components. - Ensure responsive designs for desktop, tablet, and mobile. - Collaborate with our development team to ensure smooth design implementation. - Improve the overall user experience through usability-focused design decisions.
Required Skills & Qualifications
- Proven experience as a UX/UI Designer. - Strong portfolio demonstrating web application, marketplace, or SaaS platform designs. - Excellent knowledge of Figma and modern design tools. - Experience designing complex user flows and dashboard interfaces. - Strong understanding of UX principles, responsive design, and usability. - Ability to create high-quality wireframes, prototypes, and production-ready UI designs. - Good communication skills and ability to collaborate with a remote development team. - Experience working on marketplace, e-commerce, or fintech platforms is a strong advantage.
Deliverables
- User flow diagrams. - Low-fidelity and high-fidelity wireframes. - Complete UI designs in Figma. - Interactive prototypes. - Responsive desktop and mobile layouts. - Reusable UI components and design system. - Developer-ready design files and specifications.
How to Apply
Please include the following in your proposal:
1. Your portfolio or relevant UX/UI design projects. 2. Examples of marketplace, e-commerce, or SaaS platforms you have designed. 3. Your experience with Figma and interactive prototyping. 4. Your estimated timeline and project cost. 5. Your availability to start.
We are looking for someone who can think beyond visual design and understand the complete user experience of a digital marketplace.
We value creativity, attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to deliver high-quality work.
We look forward to working with a talented designer on this project!

item.title: WordPress Navigation & Security Repair
item.description:
30-250 USD | My host’s support team disabled my site’s navigation after detecting outdated plugins that could allow malware through and downgraded something (can provide later) to allow outdated plugins to work (although they were fine prior to a malware attack but which has been scrubbed/cleaned by host). As a result, the mobile menu navigation no longer works, and the computer navigation is sluggish. Further, a CAPTCHA appeared that we did NOT have before, and was blocking form submissions from occurring. I need the site restored to full, secure functionality and this Captcha removed, as it was not there originally. I was told Malware had come in not through my WPress login, but rather a plug in that controlled navigation.
So here is the scope in plain terms: • Re-enable and repair the main and mobile menus so every link loads the correct page on both desktop and mobile views. • Identify the outdated or vulnerable plugins, update and replace any that are no longer supported or pose a security risk wit the latest best ones that protect my site from new current threats. No plugins that allow malware to enter should be used. • Remove any malicious code you discover, run a full malware scan, and harden WordPress so the problem does not recur. • Confirm there are no security warnings, redirects, or suspicious pop-ups once the work is complete including the Captcha. * Restore what they downgraded to match the old plugins. (Will provide name of it once awarded - I have to find it). * Fix sluggish responses when menu is clicked. * Make sure menu navigation works fully from page to page.
I can supply whatever access that is required — WordPress admin, hosting control panel, and backups are all available upon request.
Please let me know your approach, if you have the expertise to do this, the estimated turnaround time, and cost, so we can get the site back online quickly and safely.
Whoever does this will have ongoing potential work as needed in future.

item.title: WordPress Event Registration Integration
item.description:
30-250 CAD | I’m setting up an event on my WordPress site and need the full registration flow put in place.
Scope of work – Build or configure the WordPress form and map it to Stripe Checkout.
WordPress, Brevo & Stripe – flow process for events that is repeatable in the future and can be moved to a new website in the near future
1. Project Objective Build one complete, working event registration, payment, with email communication system using the existing WordPress website, Brevo account, and Stripe account integration. The system must support a repeatable setup to be used for independent events while only changing the event details each time. The client will provide all email content and event-specific information. The freelancer is responsible for building the flow with technical configuration, integration, automation logic, basic testing, and written documentation to sign off. The automation is to come from the existing aspects of Registration form, Brevo and Stripe Basic Concept of flow Brevo Flow = Registration form on wordpress event page>submit will add to an event list and main list>sends email of registration to client and admin >takes client to stripe payment link> On payment > adds client to secondary list of paid and if they do not pay to an Unpaid relevant to the event name and list 2 Days prior to the event email goes to unpaid list as a reminder for payment > if they pay the persons registration gets added to the paid list 8 hours prior to the event > email with event details gets sent to paid list Anyone registering and pays after this window gets added to the main list and the paid list and gets the event details via email People can register and pay up to the end of the event Email to be sent post event manual timing for the recordings.
– Connect the successful payment webhook to Brevo so the confirmation email fires instantly. – Style the email template inside Brevo to match my existing brand colors and add a calendar-add link – Test the entire flow end-to-end in both Stripe test mode and live mode, fixing any field mapping or formatting issues you notice. – Hand over clear instructions (or a short Loom) showing me how to update prices, dates, or email copy in the future.
Acceptance criteria 1. A new user can register, pay, and receive the confirmation email without manual intervention. 2. All captured data appears in both WordPress form entries and the Brevo contact record. 3. No duplicate or missing records after multiple test submissions. 4. Visual styling matches the current site on desktop and mobile.
Webpage is ready, the email content will be provided. Please quote based on your expectation of payment from this listing. If something needs to be added can be discussed. Thanks for your attention to this !

item.title: Multi-Business Booking SaaS Development
item.description:
250-750 CAD | I’m creating a cloud-based scheduling and booking platform that several independent businesses can share under one roof. Each business must be able to set up its own services—ranging from one-to-one appointments to group classes and even rentable rooms or equipment—and present real-time availability to customers.
Customers should have three payment options at checkout: pay the full amount, leave a deposit, or reserve now and settle at the appointment. Transactions need to flow seamlessly through a gateway such as Stripe or a comparable provider, with automatic receipts and refund handling.
The calendar layer is equally critical: events must appear instantly inside the app and stay in sync with external calendars (Google, Outlook, iCal) to avoid double-booking. Drag-and-drop rescheduling, staff assignment, capacity limits, and automated email/SMS reminders all belong in the core experience.
Because this is true software-as-a-service, I need a multi-tenant architecture where data is isolated yet the codebase remains single. Each tenant gets a branded portal, its own admin dashboard, and role-based permissions for owners, managers, staff, and customers.
Deliverables • Full-stack source code in a Git repo with clear setup instructions • Deployed MVP on my cloud account (AWS preferred, but flexible) • REST or GraphQL API documentation • Basic analytics and audit logs • Test suite plus a brief hand-off walkthrough
If you’ve built something similar—especially with React, Vue, Node.js, Django, or comparable stacks—tell me which technologies you’d use here and share any live examples. I’m ready to move quickly once the right approach is confirmed.

item.title: WordPress & E-Commerce Developer/Manager Needed for B2B Online Store Platform

Our objective is to create a best-in-class online experience where customers can browse products, access customized online stores, place orders, and complete transactions through an efficient and integrated workflow.
Key Responsibilities 1. WordPress Website Management Manage and maintain our existing WordPress website. Improve functionality, navigation, product presentation, and user experience. Manage plugins, themes, integrations, product content, and landing pages. Improve website performance, SEO, lead generation, and conversion opportunities. 2. Website Development Assist with the development and ongoing improvement of our next-generation website and digital platform. Translate business requirements into practical website functionality. Work with our existing development team on testing, troubleshooting, enhancements, and new functionality. Help establish scalable processes for future website development. 3. E-Commerce & Customer Online Stores Take ownership of expanding our e-commerce capabilities. Develop and manage customer-specific branded online stores. Improve product catalogues, product presentation, pricing, checkout, and order workflows. Create scalable templates and processes that allow new customer stores to be launched efficiently. Identify opportunities to automate the creation and ongoing management of online stores. Help turn our online-store offering into a meaningful and scalable revenue channel. 4. Technology & Systems Integration Help connect our WordPress website, e-commerce technology, and internal business platform. We are looking for an experienced WordPress security specialist to recover a compromised business website and potentially become our long-term technical operations partner.

Our WordPress website was recently compromised.

- A recurring maintenance agreement with predictable compensation - Performance incentives linked to measurable security and maintenance quality - Technical ownership and autonomy within an agreed scope - Preferred access to future development and automation projects - The opportunity to grow into a long-term technical partnership

**Our goal is to establish a long-term technical partnership, not just complete a one-time malware cleanup.**
